new_entities.name: InsurancePolicy
new_entities.description: An insurance policy distributed by the bank as FCA-authorised intermediary. Covers packaged account insurance products (travel, home, life). Owned by SVC-004 (Insurance Distribution Service, CAP-001.06). Not underwritten by the bank — the underwriter (Aviva) is an external counterparty.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this insurance policy

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: FK to the packaged current account this policy is associated with

fields.name: ipid_acknowledged_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when customer acknowledged IPID and Key Features Document

fields.name: annual_premium
fields.description: Annual premium (GBP) — may be zero if bundled with account fee

fields.name: consumer_duty_evidence_ref
fields.description: Reference to Consumer Duty evidence record (FCA PROD)

fields.name: bound_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when policy was bound with underwriter

relationships.description: References the packaged current account this policy is associated with

design_decisions: InsurancePolicy owned by SVC-004 (Insurance Distribution, CAP-001.06). Not owned by SVC-001.
consumer_duty_evidence_ref is mandatory — FCA PROD requires documented evidence of target market assessment and fair value assessment for every distribution.
Bank acts as intermediary only — underwriter_policy_ref is the authoritative policy reference from Aviva.

referenced_existing_entities.name: CurrentAccount
referenced_existing_entities.purpose: Packaged account to which the insurance policy is attached
